# Dagric OS — GRUB boot menu theme.
#
# Installed into the ISO at boot/grub/themes/dagric/ by
# config/hooks/normal/0950-boot-branding.hook.binary. The PNGs and .pf2 fonts
# beside this file are generated by config/bootloaders/make-boot-art.sh.
#
# What this replaces: live-build's live-theme, which set an item colour and a
# selected-item colour and nothing else. Booted in QEMU you could not tell which
# of the four entries was selected — two greys, no bar, no panel — and the only
# countdown was a stark white brick reading "The highlighted entry will be
# executed automatically in 3s.".
#
# Everything is positioned in percentages because GRUB scales the background
# image to the panel but does NOT scale fonts or 9-slice tiles. Absolute pixel
# positions tuned at 1080p end up off the bottom of a 1024x768 screen.
#
# THE FONT NAMES BELOW ARE THE PF2 *NAME* FIELD, NOT THE FAMILY, AND THE
# DIFFERENCE IS NOT COSMETIC. grub_font_get() string-compares against the NAME
# section of the .pf2 and, on no match, silently returns the first font in the
# load list — no error, no warning, a menu that just looks wrong. grub-mkfont
# builds NAME as "<family> <style> <size>", so make-boot-art.sh's
# `-n "Dagric Body 24"` on a 24px regular face yields "Dagric Body 24 Regular
# 24"; the family alone matches nothing. This theme shipped referencing the
# family and every string in the menu — entries, selection, countdown, hint —
# rendered in the 17px small face, because small.pf2 is loaded last and a
# prepended list makes the last one loaded the fallback. Booted under OVMF
# before and after: the entries go 17px -> 24px and the selected row gets its
# bold back. If you rename a font here, rename it in make-boot-art.sh and in
# the loadfont lines in 0950-boot-branding.hook.binary, and boot it to check.

desktop-image: "background.png"
# "crop" is cover, not contain: on a 4:3 panel this scales to the height and
# drops ~12.5% off each side rather than squashing the monogram into an ellipse.
desktop-image-scale-method: "crop"
desktop-image-h-align: "center"
desktop-image-v-align: "center"
desktop-color: "#05080d"

# Blank on purpose, and 0950 re-blanks it as a guard. The title renders centred
# at the top of the screen, which is exactly where the background art puts the
# DAGRIC wordmark, so any title at all prints straight through the logo.
title-text: ""
title-color: "#e8eef4"
title-font: "Dagric Small 17 Regular 17"

message-font: "Dagric Small 17 Regular 17"
message-color: "#c8d6e8"
message-bg-color: "#0b1526"

# gfxterm gets the whole screen, not an inset box. The moment the menu exits,
# gfxmenu stops painting and gfxterm clears ITS rectangle to draw GRUB's
# "Booting ..." line — which is what punched a large black box through the
# middle of the splash on the shipped ISO. theme.cfg pairs this with
# background_image on the same file so the terminal keeps drawing the same
# picture the menu was drawing; an inset rectangle would land the wordmark in
# the wrong place.
terminal-font: "Dagric Small 17 Regular 17"
terminal-left: "0"
terminal-top: "0"
terminal-width: "100%"
terminal-height: "100%"
terminal-border: "0"

# The menu panel.
#
# Two numbers here are arithmetic, not taste. Both were measured off rendered
# frames, because the two styled boxes in this component behave differently:
# menu_pixmap_style FILLS these bounds exactly (measured 132..891 x 307..570 for
# left 50%-380, width 760, top 40%, height 264 on a 1024x768 screen), while
# selected_item_pixmap_style is drawn AROUND its row.
#
# item_spacing must stay >= the pill's north + south slices, which are 10 each.
# The pill renders item_height + 20 = 50px tall, and at anything tighter it
# visibly bleeds over the row below.
#
# height decides how many entries GRUB shows AT ALL, and it buys fewer rows than
# it looks like it should. Rows drawn is
#
#   (height - 2*item_padding - 20 - 20) / (item_height + item_spacing)
#
# where the two 20s are the panel's own corner slices — the panel box lives
# inside these bounds, so its border eats into the list — and every row is
# charged its trailing item_spacing, including the last one. Four entries at
# 30+22 therefore need 284, not the 244 the naive sum gives. At 248 the ISO drew
# three of its four entries and the Utilities submenu was simply absent: no
# error, no scrollbar, no clue.
#
# FIVE ROWS, NOT FOUR, AND THE FIFTH IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS.
#
# This was sized for the ISO, which ships exactly four top-level entries, and
# that was the whole story while this theme only ever reached the USB stick. It
# is not any more: /etc/default/grub.d/50-dagric.cfg sets GRUB_THEME to this
# file, so the same fixed-height panel now draws the INSTALLED machine's menu —
# and that list is generated by /etc/grub.d and is longer. On the configuration
# this product is sold on, Windows kept alongside on UEFI firmware, it is five:
# "Dagric OS" and "Advanced options for Dagric OS" from 10_linux (nothing in
# this tree sets GRUB_DISABLE_SUBMENU or GRUB_DISABLE_RECOVERY), Windows from
# 30_os-prober (which runs now that 50-dagric.cfg sets GRUB_DISABLE_OS_PROBER
# =false), "UEFI Firmware Settings" from 30_uefi-firmware, and last, because it
# is numbered 41, the grub-btrfs submenu "Dagric snapshots".
#
# At 288 that fifth row was simply not on screen when the menu first drew, with
# scrollbar = false and no error to say so — and the fifth row is the snapshot
# rollback submenu, the recovery promise the site makes on six pages, on the one
# screen its owner reaches on the day their desktop broke. UEFI with no Windows
# is four and just leaves a row of empty panel; that is the cheap side of it.
#
# 336 is what the formula above gives for five rows; 340 rounds it up. Adding a
# sixth means raising this by 52 AND raising the progress_bar's top by the same
# 52, or the countdown draws inside the panel.
+ boot_menu {
    left = 50%-380
    top = 40%
    width = 760
    height = 340
    menu_pixmap_style = "panel_*.png"
    item_font = "Dagric Body 24 Regular 24"
    item_color = "#a9bdd6"
    selected_item_font = "Dagric Sel 24 Bold 24"
    # NOT white. The pill is the brand blue at 95% (make-boot-art.sh draws it
    # rgba(63,169,245,0.95)) and it composites over the panel to #3ca1ea —
    # measured off a booted frame, and off select_c.png directly, which agree.
    # White on that is 2.8:1. WCAG wants 4.5:1 for text and will not even give
    # 24px bold the 3:1 large-text allowance at that number, and this is the
    # ONE line on the boot screen that has to be unmistakable: it is the entry
    # that boots if the owner does nothing. Dark ink on the blue measures
    # 7.5:1 and is the same inversion the login screen already uses for
    # selected text on accent (TextInput selectedTextColor in the SDDM theme's
    # Main.qml is this exact value), so the two screens agree on what "this one
    # is chosen" looks like. Do not "fix" this back to white without booting it
    # and measuring the pixels.
    selected_item_color = "#06101c"
    selected_item_pixmap_style = "select_*.png"
    item_height = 30
    item_padding = 18
    item_spacing = 22
    icon_width = 0
    icon_height = 0
    item_icon_space = 0
    scrollbar = false
}

# The countdown.
#
# The text has to live on the progress_bar. GRUB substitutes the seconds only
# here — a label carrying id "__timeout__" renders the literal macro string, no
# matter what the theme tutorials say. Any value other than the three
# @TIMEOUT_NOTIFICATION_*@ names is used as a printf template, which is how this
# says something in Dagric's own words instead of "The highlighted entry will be
# executed automatically in 3s.".
#
# Only one component may hold id "__timeout__"; GRUB takes the first match.
#
# Offset from the panel's top rather than pinned to the bottom of the screen:
# the panel is a fixed pixel height (GRUB cannot scale a font, so it cannot
# scale a menu), and a percentage down here would leave it welded to the panel
# at 768 and stranded 300px below it at 1080p.
#
# The offset is boot_menu's height plus a 32px gap, so it has to move whenever
# the panel does — it was 288+32 and is now 340+32. On the shortest screen this
# theme targets, 1024x768, the panel runs 307..647 and this bar 679..699, still
# clear of the hint label below at 716. Raise both numbers or neither.
+ progress_bar {
    id = "__timeout__"
    left = 50%-260
    top = 40%+372
    width = 520
    height = 20
    show_text = true
    font = "Dagric Small 17 Regular 17"
    text_color = "#eaf2ff"
    text = "Starting Dagric OS in %ds"
    bar_style = "pbbg_*.png"
    highlight_style = "pbfg_*.png"
}

+ label {
    left = 0
    top = 100%-52
    width = 100%
    align = "center"
    color = "#68809b"
    font = "Dagric Small 17 Regular 17"
    text = "Enter to start        Up / Down to choose        E to edit"
}
